summary: Felaris now has a sidebar and top controls that slide into view on hover, site favicons, History, Settings, and built-in uBlock Origin Lite. Sign-in popups open in their own window. Tabs have a context menu with duplicate and workspace actions, and the search palette includes history suggestions. This release also adds window-edge resizing, fullscreen and zoom shortcuts, improves large tab sessions, and protects pinned tabs and active downloads when closing other tabs.
